title: JANUS Engine R0P1 — parasitic metering harness and subsystem isolation gate
purpose: Replace every remaining auxiliary-power placeholder with directly measured electrical/mechanical/hydraulic data and uncertainty before repeating the integrated energy-balance run.

electrical_channels: AFPM inverter DC input/output and phase current
hydrogen-feed valve/regulator electronics if electrically active
mechanical_hydraulic_channels: purge pressure before/after and recovered pressure
process_state_channels: Bx/By/Bz where magnetic-loss mapping is active

subsystem_isolation_sequence.goal: map pump W and DeltaP versus Q with POMS path installed
map fan/blower W versus gas flow and humidity-management DeltaP
map AFPM support W versus RPM/torque and no-current drag
measure joules per purge event, gas mass lost/returned and pressure recovery
measure crystal-trap DeltaP and wiper incremental torque clean versus loaded
prove passive heat-rejection path or meter active thermal watts
run all subsystems together and verify that sum of isolated channels agrees with bus-level power within uncertainty

purge_accounting.gas_work_boundary: pressure/gas loss must be accounted separately from solenoid electrical energy
purge_accounting.rule: A 30-minute purge heartbeat does not imply a full 2-atm blowdown; 2 atm remains the maximum requested transient pressure loss, not a target.

AFPM_accounting.generator_region: credit DC charge only against independently measured mechanical input or rotor kinetic-energy decrease
AFPM_accounting.required_sync: RPM + torque + DC bus power + phase current + B-field

sampling.AFPM_phase_and_EPM_switching: kHz-class or faster as required to resolve switching/harmonics
sampling.energy_integral_rule: Use time-integrated Wh/J, not snapshot watts, for startup and purge decisions

replacement_rule: A RUN-006/RUN-007 placeholder is deleted only after a directly measured value/range plus uncertainty and operating condition are recorded.

closure_test.equation: P_aux_measured = sum(all simultaneously active measured loads)
closure_test.bus_crosscheck: P_PEMFC + P_battery_discharge + P_verified_regen - P_battery_charge - P_aux_measured - P_export = 0 within declared uncertainty
closure_test.pass: isolated-channel sum and common-bus measurement agree within the measurement uncertainty over steady windows and transient energy integrals close over startup/hold/shutdown

next_after_pass: RUN008_FULL_MEASURED_ENERGY_BALANCE: rerun the integrated Calcifer trajectory using only measured POMS flux, PEMFC conversion, subsystem parasitics, AFPM maps and dual-pack Wh.
